source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 5 词表(p58-67 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、急救/烧伤烫伤/心肺复苏/海姆立克法主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Knowing first aid can help you save a life in an emergency.
words.example_cn: 懂得急救能帮你在紧急情况下挽救生命。

words.example_en: If acid touches your skin, wash the area with cool water at once.
words.example_cn: 如果酸接触到皮肤,立刻用凉水冲洗该处。

words.example_en: Place the burn under cool running water for at least ten minutes.
words.example_cn: 把烧伤处放在凉水下冲至少十分钟。

words.example_en: The nurse cleaned the wound before she covered it with a cloth.
words.example_cn: 护士在用布盖住伤口之前先把它清洗干净。

words.example_en: We gave first aid to the victim before the ambulance arrived.
words.example_cn: 在救护车到来之前,我们给受害者进行了急救。

words.example_en: She called an ambulance as soon as the old man collapsed.
words.example_cn: 老人一倒下,她就叫了救护车。

words.example_en: A man at the next table was choking on a piece of steak.
words.example_cn: 邻桌的一个男人被一块牛排噎住了。

words.example_en: The patient suddenly collapsed before the doctor could reach him.
words.example_cn: 病人在医生赶到之前突然昏倒了。

words.example_en: A child can easily choke if they swallow something too quickly.
words.example_cn: 孩子如果吞咽得太快,很容易噎住。

words.example_en: He was holding his throat because the food was stuck inside.
words.example_cn: 他捂着喉咙,因为食物卡在了里面。

words.example_en: The sprained ankle began to swell soon after she slipped.
words.example_cn: 扭伤的脚踝在她滑倒后不久就开始肿胀。

words.example_en: Her swollen ankle was red and very painful to touch.
words.example_cn: 她肿胀的脚踝又红又痛,一碰就疼。

words.example_en: He fell off his bike and sprained his ankle badly.
words.example_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来,严重扭伤了脚踝。

words.example_en: She could not stand because her ankle was broken.
words.example_cn: 她站不起来,因为踝关节骨折了。

words.example_en: He slipped on the wet floor and hurt his back.
words.example_cn: 他在湿地板上滑倒,伤了背。

words.example_en: The lifeguard ran to help the boy before he could drown.
words.example_cn: 救生员在男孩溺水前跑过去救他。

words.example_en: A serious burn needs urgent attention at a hospital.
words.example_cn: 严重烧伤需要在医院得到紧急处理。

words.example_en: When you give first aid, stay calm and do not panic.
words.example_cn: 进行急救时要保持冷静,不要惊慌。

words.example_en: He heard someone scream for help from another table.
words.example_cn: 他听见有人从另一桌大声呼救。

words.example_en: Grab your fist tightly and push up into the person's stomach.
words.example_cn: 紧紧握住自己的拳头,向上推压对方的腹部。

words.example_en: Make a fist and place it on the upper part of the stomach.
words.example_cn: 握成拳头,放在腹部上方。

words.example_en: Stand behind the victim and wrap your arms around his waist.
words.example_cn: 站在受害者身后,用双臂环住他的腰。

words.example_en: Slapping the choking person's back may force out the food.
words.example_cn: 拍打噎住者的背部也许能把食物拍出来。

words.example_en: Push up and into the stomach in one quick motion.
words.example_cn: 用一个快速的动作向上、向内推压腹部。

words.example_en: Cover the burnt area with a loose clean cloth.
words.example_cn: 用一块宽松干净的布盖住烧伤的部位。

words.meaning_cn: 牢固的;紧的;绷紧的;紧紧地
words.example_en: Hold the cloth tight so that the bleeding stops.
words.example_cn: 把布按紧,好让出血止住。

words.example_en: Grab your fist tightly with your other hand.
words.example_cn: 用另一只手紧紧握住你的拳头。

words.example_en: Do not pull off clothes if the fabric is sticking to the burnt skin.
words.example_cn: 如果布料粘在烧伤的皮肤上,不要把衣服扯下来。

words.example_en: A serious burn can damage every layer of the skin.
words.example_cn: 严重的烧伤会损坏皮肤的每一层。

words.example_en: Chemicals can harm your internal organs if they are swallowed.
words.example_cn: 化学品如果被吞下,会损害你的内脏器官。

words.example_en: A third-degree burn may damage the nerves under the skin.
words.example_cn: 三度烧伤可能损坏皮肤下的神经。

words.example_en: Keep pushing until the obstruction is forced out of the throat.
words.example_cn: 持续推压,直到阻塞物从喉咙里被推出来。

words.example_en: His dinner was interrupted when he heard someone scream.
words.example_cn: 他听到有人尖叫,晚餐被打断了。

words.meaning_cn: 绝望的;拼命的;非常需要的
words.example_en: His desperate friends were slapping him hard on the back.
words.example_cn: 他焦急绝望的朋友们正在用力拍他的背。

words.example_en: A minor burn can be treated at home with cool water.
words.example_cn: 轻微的烧伤可以在家里用凉水处理。

words.meaning_cn: 切实可行的;实际的;实用的
words.example_en: The Heimlich manoeuvre is quick, practical and easy to learn.
words.example_cn: 海姆立克急救法快速、实用,而且容易学。

words.meaning_cn: 减轻;缓解;宽慰;容易;舒适
words.example_en: Cool water can ease the pain of a small burn.
words.example_cn: 凉水能减轻小烧伤的疼痛。

words.example_en: The team gave her oxygen without delay and checked her vital signs.
words.example_cn: 急救队毫不耽搁地给她吸氧,并检查了她的生命体征。

words.example_en: He said he could not justify sitting there and doing nothing.
words.example_cn: 他说他无法为坐在那里什么都不做而辩解。

words.example_en: We all have a responsibility to look after one another's welfare.
words.example_cn: 我们都有责任照顾彼此的安康。

words.meaning_cn: 年纪较大的;上了年纪的
words.example_en: The elderly woman lived alone and could not get up after she fell.
words.example_cn: 这位上了年纪的妇人独自居住,摔倒后无法起身。

words.example_en: She had to stay in the hospital ward for a week.
words.example_cn: 她不得不在医院病房里住了一周。

words.example_en: The paramedic put in an IV needle and gave her oxygen.
words.example_cn: 急救医生插入静脉注射针,并给她吸氧。

words.example_en: A deep burn can reach the layers underneath the skin.
words.example_cn: 深度烧伤会伤及皮肤下面的各层。

words.example_en: Some insect bites leave a toxin that makes the skin swell.
words.example_cn: 有些虫咬会留下毒素,使皮肤肿胀。

words.example_en: Strong radiation from the sun can also burn your skin.
words.example_cn: 来自太阳的强辐射也会灼伤你的皮肤。

words.example_en: He was woken by the bright rays of sunlight in the morning.
words.example_cn: 早晨他被明亮的阳光照醒。

words.example_en: The operator stayed calm and told the boy exactly what to do.
words.example_cn: 接线员保持镇定,准确地告诉男孩该怎么做。

words.example_en: The paramedics checked his vital signs and took him to hospital.
words.example_cn: 急救人员检查了他的生命体征,并把他送往医院。

words.meaning_cn: 使用手册;说明书;用手的;手工的
words.example_en: He learned the steps from a first-aid manual at school.
words.example_cn: 他在学校从一本急救手册上学会了这些步骤。
